summary: The thyroid-monitoring-harmonization task failed because the agent applied incorrect conversion factor direction for Total_T3 (factor < 1 requires multiplication, not division). The agent eventually fixed this by tracking (factor, direction) tuples instead of simple division. The key insight is that conversion factor direction must be explicit when factors can be < 1, and threshold-based detection needs analyte-specific plausible ranges. This extends the clinical-lab-harmonization skill with thyroid-specific analytes and a more robust conversion factor pattern.
